_about: Settings for the fact sheets (engine/profiles/): one per suburb of the City of Melbourne (the units the map uses; the three slivers under 300 people have no Census profile). 'The subway' here is the metropolitan train network: train_stations and train_lines, each line in its group's colour (city.css). Trams are counted like Toronto's streetcars. The hub is Flinders Street; the City Loop and Metro Tunnel stations are the hubs counted for changes.

page.description: Printable one-page fact sheets for each suburb of the City of Melbourne: trains, trams and buses, freeways, drive times, public car parks, parks, libraries and schools. Drop a pin for walk and drive times from any spot.
page.boundary: Suburb boundary (ABS Suburbs and Localities 2021, cut to the City)
page.pinned: Pinned spot (rounded to about 100 m) in {name}
page.outside: That spot is outside the City of Melbourne. Try a spot inside the City.
page.noMatch: No match in the City of Melbourne for “{q}”. Try the full street address, like “90 Swanston Street”.
